incident.summary: Removing a project worktree that contained a node_modules junction emptied the canonical junction target.
reproducedBy: git worktree remove on a clean worktree containing the junction
PowerShell Remove-Item on the junction without recursive flags

supersedingWorktreePolicy.dependencyStrategy: Run npm ci independently in each acquisition worktree.
cleanupOrder: Validate the worker branch and worktree are clean or fully preserved.
Remove only the isolated worktree through git worktree remove.
Retain failed and rejected branches required for audit lineage.
supersedingWorktreePolicy.reason: The measured disk has ample headroom, while junction cleanup is destructive to the shared dependency target in this Windows environment.
